# Access CBT

> Access CBT provides evidence-based Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, EMDR, and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy services in Liverpool with both in-person and online appointments.

Access CBT specializes in treating common mental health conditions including depression, anxiety, OCD, PTSD, and social anxiety using modern therapeutic approaches aligned with DSM-V and ICD-10 standards. The practice offers multiple evidence-based modalities delivered by qualified therapists in Liverpool and the North West.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing)
- Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
- Depression treatment
- Anxiety disorders
- PTSD and trauma therapy
- OCD treatment
- Social Anxiety Disorder
- Cognitive Model
- Behavioural Activation
- Mental health counselling
- Liverpool therapist
- Online therapy
- Emotion regulation
- Psychotherapy

## Core Therapy Services

- [Cognitive Behaviour Therapy in Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/cognitive-behaviour-therapy-in-liverpool): Expert CBT services using 5 areas formulation for comprehensive mental health treatment
- [EMDR Therapy Liverpool and the North West](https://accesscbt.co.uk/emdr-therapy-in-liverpool): EMDR therapy for PTSD and trauma using bilateral stimulation and Adaptive Information Processing
- [Acceptance and Commitment Therapy Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/acceptance-and-commitment-therapy-liverpool): Third-wave CBT alternative addressing experiential avoidance and cognitive defusion
- [Counselling in Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/counselling-in-liverpool): Comprehensive counselling services with in-person and online Zoom appointments

## Condition-Specific Treatment

- [Therapy for Depression Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-depression-liverpool): CBT for depression using Cognitive Model and behavioural activation techniques
- [Therapy for Anxiety Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-anxiety): CBT guide for Generalised Anxiety Disorder and worry management techniques
- [CBT for Social Anxiety](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-social-anxiety-liverpool): CBT treatment for Social Anxiety Disorder addressing avoidance patterns and social phobia
- [Therapy for PTSD in Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-ptsd-liverpool): PTSD therapy using CBT and EMDR approaches aligned with DSM-V and ICD-10 standards
- [Therapy for OCD Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-ocd-liverpool): Evidence-based CBT treatment for OCD addressing intrusive thoughts and compulsions
- [Therapy for Anger Management Liverpool](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-anger-management): CBT and EMDR therapy for anger management and emotion regulation

## Mental Health Resources

- [Treatments for Depression](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-depression): Comprehensive guide to depression treatments and talking therapies with CBT
- [Treatment for Social Anxiety](https://accesscbt.co.uk/therapy-for-social-anxiety): Treatment guide for Social Anxiety Disorder as third most common mental disorder
